'''Minister of the Army''' was a ministerial position within the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government. The office holder was the ministerial head of the [[New Republic Army]]. 

==History==
[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], a former [[General/Legends|General]] ascended to the position following the decimation of the [[New Republic Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] corps during the [[Second Battle of Coruscant|surprise Imperial assault]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He served the [[Inner Council (New Republic)|Inner Council]] and [[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]].<ref name="JASB" /> By [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]],<ref name="DateEnd" /> the position had been abolished and the responsibilities were taken by the post of [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
